name: Tuft & Needle First Responder Discount
description: 15% off all products for first responders, military, and healthcare workers
fullDescription: Tuft & Needle offers first responders, military members and veterans, and healthcare workers 15% off the original price of all its products, ordered by phone.
whatTheyOffer:
- 15% off original prices on your whole order
- Applies to mattresses, bed frames, pillows, sheets, and bedding
- Also available to active military, veterans, and healthcare workers
- Cannot be combined with other promotions
- Free shipping and a 100-night trial
howToGetIt:
1. Call Tuft & Needle customer support at (877) 842-2586
2. Tell them you are a first responder (law enforcement, paramedic, EMT, or firefighter)
3. They will process your discounted order over the phone
keywords: Tuft & Needle, first responder, mattress, sleep, 15% off, firefighter, police, EMT
